nonuniform.translation:
a. 不一致的, 不均匀的, 不统一的
[电] 不均匀

nonuniformities.definition:
plural of nonuniformity
n. the quality of being diverse and interesting
nonuniformities.translation: (nonuniformity 的复数) [计] 非一致性

nonuniformity.definition: n. the quality of being diverse and interesting

nonunion.definition: a. not belonging to or not allowing affiliation with a trade union
nonunion.translation:
a. 不属于工会的, 不承认工会的
[医] 骨不连合

nonunionist.definition:
n. One who does not belong, or refuses to belong, to a
   trades union.

nonuple.definition: s. having nine units or components
nonuple.translation: a. 九倍的, 九重的

nonuse.translation:
n. 不使用, 不形成习惯
[法] 不使用

nonuser.definition:
A not using; failure to use.
 Neglect or omission to use an easement or franchise or to
   assert a right.
nonuser.translation:
n. 不行使权利, 放弃权利, 不使用者
[法] 弃权, 不行使权利, 权利消失
